name: multi-skill-session
summary: Deterministic, index-parameterised Claude Code session. Each run with OTBOX_FAKE_SESSION_INDEX=N invokes a slash-command skill (skill-alpha for even N, skill-beta for odd N), Reads + Edits a fresh src/feature_<N>.py, and mints a distinct session_id (sess-otbox-multi-skill-<N>). Drives plan 068 M68-3's c-captured-multi-skill checkpoint: 3 captured sessions across 3 commits exercising 2 distinct skills, so dataset-sync-with-history journeys (plan 070) have a real multi-trace, multi-skill substrate.
